standard_prerequisites.use: Replace B by the image of A to B without changing X or the sheaves O_X(n).

standard_prerequisites.name: Surjective case
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives parts (1) and (2) and surjectivity in (3).

core_obligations: Replace B by the image of A to B using the two named lemmas, so A to B may be assumed surjective.
Parts (1) and (2) and surjectivity in (3) come from the surjective-case card.
Both O_X(n) and O_Y(n) are invertible, so the surjective map theta: r_psi^* O_X(n) to O_Y(n) between invertible sheaves is an isomorphism.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the surjective case by replacing the target with the image, apply the closed-immersion card, and close part (3) by invertibility.
difficulty_reason: Reduction replacing B by the image of A to B through two named lemmas, the closed-immersion conclusion from the surjective case, and the final isomorphism inference from invertibility of the twists; fully displayed stepwise.
